text: For a finite set of n-qubit Pauli observables, the projected stabilizer polytope is the image of the n-qubit stabilizer polytope under projection onto the corresponding expectation-value coordinates.
The reduced robustness of magic is the minimum l1 norm of real affine coefficients that reconstruct the measured expectation vector from a generating set of the projected stabilizer polytope.
For a fixed Pauli measurement set, the source asserts that reduced robustness of magic does not increase under any trace-preserving stabilizer operation.

For a finite set of n-qubit Pauli strings, the projected stabilizer polytope equals the convex hull of vectors indexed by inclusion-maximal independent sets of the anticommutation graph and source-admissible sign assignments.
